title: Partial-State Deadzone-Adapted Disturbance Suppression Control For Strict-Feedback Systems
summary: In this paper we provide an extension of the partial-state Deadzone-Adapted Disturbance Suppression (DADS) adaptive control scheme in the case of strict-feedback systems. We study two cases: the cases of strict-feedback systems with and without integrators. The DADS controller achieves attenuation of the output to an assignable small level, despite the presence of (time-varying) disturbances, unknown (time-varying) parameters and unknown (time-varying) input coefficients; all of them with arbitrary and unknown bounds.
